_comment: Clients that consume this Ollama server. Copy to clients.json and set
models            - warn when a model the client needs is installed nowhere.
context_length    - static declaration of the client's context window.
context_length_file / context_length_key - read the window from the client's OWN
config, so the check follows drift instead of trusting a
number someone typed here once. The key is a dotted path;
when it lands on a mapping the largest integer under it wins.
context_length_match - keep only mapping keys containing this substring. Needed
when one file holds several providers and a cloud model
really does have a 200k window, which would otherwise be
compared against a 65k local server and cry wolf.
Point it at the file that actually CONTROLS behaviour. Hermes' effective window
auto-probed context_length_cache.yaml -- so that cache legitimately still holds
the model's architectural 262144 and is not a misconfiguration.
A client sized to a larger window than OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH will fill the real
one and have every reply truncated -- see AGENTS.md.
